WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
),
latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
),
latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated  = ca.dt_date
       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date
       AND cad.as_of_date    = ca.as_of_date
),
latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                  AS asset_code,
           reporting_name,
           investment_name,
           investment_desc_il                                AS investment_description,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))              AS model_portfolio_id,
           CONCAT('RD', UPPER(SUBSTR(TRIM(asset_code), 2)))  AS debt_model_portfolio_id,
           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,
           programmatic_investment_il,
           al_investment_name,
           investment_type_il,
           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2
           investment_stage_current_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,
           market_type,
           country_region_il,
           reporting_currency_il,
           sector_focus_level_1_il,
           sector_focus_level_2_il,
           funding_bucket_il,
           il_investment_structure_level_1,
           il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_count_il,
           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'
),
latest_yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.as_of_date,
           ild.business_date,
           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,
           ild.reporting_name,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_description,
           ild.investment_type_il,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           ild.country_exposure_il,
           ild.currency_exposure_il,
           ild.country_region_il,
           ild.market_type,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count_il,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity                             AS net_invested_equity_base_currency,
           lie.net_invested_equity                            AS net_invested_equity_local_currency,
           df2.commitment                                     AS commitment_base_currency,
           df3.commitment                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           df2.cad_allocation                                 AS allocation_base_currency,
           df3.allocation                                     AS allocation_local_currency,
           df2.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           df3.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date           
),
latest_yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value_base_currency
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current
                    FROM latest_yardi_deals
              )
      )
),
real_estate_yardi_investment_level_holdings AS (
    SELECT asset_code                                                    AS investment_code,
           as_of_date                                                    AS as_of_date,
           CAST(DATE_PARSE(business_date , '%Y%m%d') AS DATE)            AS business_date,
           model_portfolio_id                                            AS model_portfolio_id,
           debt_model_portfolio_id                                       AS debt_model_portfolio_id,
           investment_name                                               AS investment_name,
           investment_description                                        AS investment_description,
           investment_agg_il                                             AS investment_aggregate_name,
           reporting_name                                                AS reporting_name,
           investment_type_il                                            AS investment_type,
           allocation_name_il                                            AS allocation_name,
           country_exposure_il                                           AS country_of_exposure,
           currency_exposure_il                                          AS currency_of_exposure,
           country_region_il                                             AS country_or_region,
           market_type                                                   AS market_type,
           cppib_ownership_perc                                          AS cppib_ownership_percentage,
           il_governance_structure_level_1                               AS investment_structure,
           investment_stage_current_il                                   AS investment_stage,
           geographic_focus                                              AS geographic_focus,
           sector_focus_level_1_il                                       AS sector_focus,
           sector_focus_level_2_il                                       AS sub_sector_focus,
           il_investment_structure_level_1                               AS investment_department,
           il_investment_structure_level_2                               AS investment_group,
           il_investment_structure_level_3                               AS business_unit,
           reporting_currency_il                                         AS local_reporting_currency,
           investment_count_il                                           AS investment_count,
           emerging_market_il                                            AS developed_emerging_country,
           investment_manager_il                                         AS investment_manager,
           allocations_current                                           AS allocation,
           commitments_current                                           AS commitments,
           uncommitted_allocation_current                                AS uncommitted_allocation,
           gross_invested_equity_current                                 AS gross_invested_equity,
           expenses_inside_commitment_current                            AS expenses_inside_commitment,
           capital_additions_current                                     AS capital_additions,
           temporary_roc_current                                         AS temporary_roc,
           invested_commitment_current                                   AS invested_commitment,
           unfunded_commitment_current                                   AS unfunded_commitment,
           unfunded_commitment_base_currency                             AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           unfunded_commitment_local_currency                            AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
           gross_invested_equity_historical                              AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           temporary_roc_cad                                             AS temporary_roc_historical,
           permanent_roc_cad                                             AS permanent_roc_historical,
           net_invested_equity_base_currency                             AS net_invested_equity_base_currency,
           net_invested_equity_local_currency                            AS net_invested_equity_local_currency,
           carrying_value_base_currency                                  AS carrying_value_base_currency,
           debt_carrying_value_base_currency                             AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
           equity_carrying_value_base_currency                           AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           carrying_value_local_currency                                 AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           debt_carrying_value_local_currency                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           equity_carrying_value_local_currency                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           commitment_base_currency                                      AS commitment_base_currency,
           commitment_local_currency                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           allocation_base_currency                                      AS allocation_base_currency,
           allocation_local_currency                                     AS allocation_local_currency,
           equity_exposure                                               AS exposure,
           occupied_area                                                 AS occupied_area,
           total_area                                                    AS total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_deals_with_derived_fields yd
),
yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ydn.*,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name
      FROM real_estate_yardi_investment_level_holdings ydn
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc  ON mpc.model_portfolio_id = ydn.model_portfolio_id
),
investran_deals AS (
    SELECT d.business_date                                            AS business_date,
           reporting_end_date,
           abor_security_id,
           mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           reporting_name,
           investran_deal_name,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name,
           active_or_liquidated,
           investment_structure_1_source,
           investment_structure_2_source,
           investment_structure_3_source,
           family,
           pi_taxonomy,
           primary_investment_category,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(equity_ownership_percentage, '\d+(\.\d+)?') AS equity_ownership_percentage,
           industry_focus,
           geographic_focus,
           CASE developed_or_emerging
               WHEN 'Emerging Markets' THEN 'Emerging'
               ELSE developed_or_emerging
           END                                                        AS developed_or_emerging,
           country_of_exposure,
           deal_local_currency,
           deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           cost_base_cur,
           carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur,
           total_exposure_base_cur,
           items_affecting_unfunded_base_itd,
           return_of_capital_permanent_base_itd,
           return_of_capital_recallable_base_itd
      FROM investran_real_asset_deals            d
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc ON mpc.model_portfolio_id = d.model_portfolio_id
),
ra_deals AS (
    SELECT (SELECT reporting_period FROM latest_fiscal_quarter)               AS reporting_period,
           business_date                                                      AS business_date,
           reporting_end_date                                                 AS as_of_date,
           abor_security_id                                                   AS investment_code,
           investran_deal_name                                                AS investment_name,
           reporting_name                                                     AS investment_aggregate_name,
           reporting_name                                                     AS reporting_name,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                              AS allocation_name,
           model_portfolio_name                                               AS model_portfolio_name,
           CAST(equity_ownership_percentage AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                AS cppib_ownership_percentage,
           pi_taxonomy                                                        AS investment_structure,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                              AS investment_stage,
           country_of_exposure                                                AS geographic_focus,
           industry_focus                                                     AS sector_focus,
           primary_investment_category                                        AS sub_sector_focus,
           investment_structure_1_source                                      AS investment_department,
           investment_structure_2_source                                      AS investment_group,
           investment_structure_3_source                                      AS business_unit,
           deal_local_currency                                                AS local_reporting_currency,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                              AS investment_count,
           developed_or_emerging                                              AS developed_emerging_country,
           family                                                             AS investment_manager,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS allocation,
           CAST(deal_commitment_amt_base_cur AS DECIMAL(32, 8))               AS commitments,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS uncommitted_allocation,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS gross_invested_equity,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS expenses_inside_commitment,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS capital_additions,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS temporary_roc,
           -1 * CAST(return_of_capital_recallable_base_itd AS DECIMAL(32, 8)) AS temporary_roc_historical,
           -1 * CAST(items_affecting_unfunded_base_itd AS DECIMAL(32, 8))     AS invested_commitment, 
           CAST(unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur AS DECIMAL(32, 8))           AS unfunded_commitment,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS unfunded_commitment_historical,
           -1 * CAST(return_of_capital_permanent_base_itd AS DECIMAL(32, 8))  AS permanent_roc_historical,
           CAST(cost_base_cur AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                              AS net_invested_equity,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS asset_carrying_value,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS debt_carrying_value,
           CAST(carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur AS DECIMAL(32, 8))            AS equity_carrying_value,
           CAST(total_exposure_base_cur AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                    AS exposure,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS occupied_area,
           CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                       AS total_area,
           active_or_liquidated                                               AS active_or_liquidated
      FROM investran_deals
 UNION
    SELECT (SELECT reporting_period FROM latest_fiscal_quarter)               AS reporting_period,
           business_date                                                      AS business_date,
           as_of_date                                                         AS as_of_date,
           investment_code                                                    AS investment_code,
           investment_name                                                    AS investment_name,
           investment_aggregate_name                                          AS investment_aggregate_name,
           reporting_name                                                     AS reporting_name,
           allocation_name                                                    AS allocation_name,
           model_portfolio_name                                               AS model_portfolio_name,
           CAST(cppib_ownership_percentage AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                 AS cppib_ownership_percentage,
           investment_structure                                               AS investment_structure,
           investment_stage                                                   AS investment_stage,
           geographic_focus                                                   AS geographic_focus,
           sector_focus                                                       AS sector_focus,
           sub_sector_focus                                                   AS sub_sector_focus,
           investment_department                                              AS investment_department,
           investment_group                                                   AS investment_group,
           business_unit                                                      AS business_unit,
           local_reporting_currency                                           AS local_reporting_currency,
           investment_count                                                   AS investment_count,
           developed_emerging_country                                         AS developed_emerging_country,
           investment_manager                                                 AS investment_manager,
           CAST(allocation AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                 AS allocation,
           CAST(commitments AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                AS commitments,
           CAST(uncommitted_allocation AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                     AS uncommitted_allocation,
           CAST(gross_invested_equity AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                      AS gross_invested_equity,
           CAST(gross_invested_equity_historical AS DECIMAL(32, 8))           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           CAST(expenses_inside_commitment AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                 AS expenses_inside_commitment,  
           CAST(capital_additions AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                          AS capital_additions,
           CAST(temporary_roc AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                              AS temporary_roc,
           CAST(temporary_roc_historical AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                   AS temporary_roc_historical,
           CAST(invested_commitment AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                        AS invested_commitment,
           CAST(unfunded_commitment AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                        AS unfunded_commitment,
           CAST(unfunded_commitment_base_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 8))          AS unfunded_commitment_historical,
           CAST(permanent_roc_historical AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                   AS permanent_roc_historical,
           CAST(net_invested_equity_base_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 8))          AS net_invested_equity,
           CAST(carrying_value_base_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 8))               AS asset_carrying_value,
           CAST(debt_carrying_value_base_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 8))          AS debt_carrying_value,
           CAST(equity_carrying_value_base_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 8))        AS equity_carrying_value,
           CAST(exposure AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                   AS exposure,
           CAST(occupied_area AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                              AS occupied_area,
           CAST(total_area AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                 AS total_area,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                              AS active_or_liquidated
      FROM yardi_deals yd
)
    SELECT (SELECT reporting_period FROM latest_fiscal_quarter) AS "Reporting Period",
           investment_code                                      AS "Investment Code",
           investment_name                                      AS "Legal Entity Name",
           investment_aggregate_name                            AS "Investment Name",
           reporting_name                                       AS "Reporting Name",
           allocation_name                                      AS "Allocation Name",
           model_portfolio_name                                 AS "Herbi Name",
           cppib_ownership_percentage / 100                     AS "CPPIB Percentage Ownership",
           COALESCE(investment_structure, 'N/A')                AS "Investment Structure",
           COALESCE(investment_stage, 'N/A')                    AS "Investment Stage - Current",
           COALESCE(geographic_focus, 'N/A')                    AS "Geographic Focus",
           COALESCE(sector_focus, 'N/A')                        AS "Sector",
           COALESCE(sub_sector_focus, 'N/A')                    AS "Subsector",
           COALESCE(investment_department, 'N/A')               AS "Business Group",
           COALESCE(investment_group, 'N/A')                    AS "Business Subgroup",
           COALESCE(business_unit, 'N/A')                       AS "Business Unit",
           COALESCE(local_reporting_currency, 'N/A')            AS "Investment Reporting Currency",
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                AS "Realized / Unrealized",
           investment_count                                     AS "Investment Count",
           COALESCE(developed_emerging_country, 'N/A')          AS "Developed/Emerging Country",
           COALESCE(investment_manager, 'N/A')                  AS "Investment Manager",
           allocation                                           AS "Allocations",
           commitments                                          AS "Commitment",
           uncommitted_allocation                               AS "Uncommitted Allocation",
           gross_invested_equity                                AS "Gross Invested Equity (Converted @ Current FX)",
           expenses_inside_commitment                           AS "Expenses Inside Commitment (Converted @ Current FX)",
           capital_additions                                    AS "Capital Additions (Converted @ Current FX)",

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (

           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date

 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date

        WHEN pv.node_name = 'Funds & Secondaries~CORE' THEN 'Funds & Secondaries'

        WHEN pv.node_name = 'Private Equity Asia~CORE' THEN 'Private Equity Asia'
        WHEN pv.node_name = 'Growth Equity (P)~CORE' THEN 'Growth Equity'

	smp.sst_custody_account_code,
	st.model_portfolio_id,
	st.business_transaction_code,
	st.settlement_currency,
	cast(st.trade_date as date) as trade_date,
	cast(st.payment_date as date) as payment_date,
	st.nominal,
	st.nominal_basis,
	st.elementary_transaction_code,
	st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
	st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
	st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
	st.reconciliation_status,
	st.created_date,
	ep.party_id,
	ep.epm_party_name,
	st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
	st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
	st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
	st.external_short_tag,
	st.settlement_date,
	st.quotation_currency,
	st.number_of_units,
	case when ss.abor_security_type_id in ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') and st.abor_security_name like '%CAD%' then 'Y'
	when ss.abor_security_type_id in ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') then 'N'
	end cross_deal_indicator,
	st.settlement_location,
	es.esm_country_code,
	rec.country_ref_code,
	rcc_exchange_country.country_name esm_country_name,
	rcc_incorp_country.country_name esm_incorp_country_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_id,
	ss.abor_security_group_name,
	ss.abor_security_type_name,
	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	rcc_trade_country.country_name country_ref_name,
	rcc.currency_name quotation_currency_name,
	st.price price_qc,
	st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency price_pc,
	st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
	es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
	es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	smp.investment_strategy_name,
	smp.investment_department_name,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.investment_type_name,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
	st.portfolio_id,
	st.ibor_reason,
	ss.abor_coupon_rate,
	st.dividend_per_share,
	st.borrowing_account,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency
from (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_transaction_number_primary_key order by business_date desc) as rn
	from trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
	where transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) st
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio )
	and st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_party_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from party.enterprise_party
) ep
	on st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id
	and ep.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	and ss.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities )
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and rec.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country
	on es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
	and rcc_exchange_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
	and rcc_incorp_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
	)sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
	select abor_transaction_number,
    		business_date,
    		transaction_cancellation_flag,
    		trade_date,
    		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
 	from trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
 	group by abor_transaction_number,
    	business_date,
    	transaction_cancellation_flag,
    	trade_date
	) stc
	on st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
	--and st.business_date = stc.business_date
	and st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
	and st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
left join reference.reference_currency_codes rcc
	on st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
	and rcc.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_currency_codes )
where st.rn = 1) AS "transactions_base"
LIMIT 1000

WITH 
	cred_exp_by_country AS
	  (
		SELECT
		  COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code) AS country,
		  parent.sovr_country_rating AS rating,
		  parent.sovr_country_outlook AS outlook,
		  GREATEST(0, SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(fact.credit_exposure, 0) ELSE 0 END )) AS tot_exposure,
		  parent.sovr_fi_limit AS tot_limit,
		  MAX( parent.region_fi_limit ) AS region_fi_limit
		FROM radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact 
		JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
		LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_prod.ref_country ref_country ON ref_country.business_date = parent.business_date and parent.domicile_country_code = ref_country.alpha_2_code
		WHERE
		  fact.business_date='2025-06-02'
		  and fact.business_date = child.business_date
          and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
          and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
          and fact.business_date = ref_country.business_date
		  AND parent.sovr_fi_limit IS NOT NULL
		  AND ( parent.IS_FI IS NOT NULL OR child.IS_FI IS NOT NULL )
		  AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
		GROUP BY
		  COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code),
		  parent.sovr_country_rating,
		  parent.sovr_country_outlook,
		  parent.sovr_fi_limit
	  )

	SELECT *
	FROM
	  (
		SELECT
		  country,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN 'OK'
		    WHEN (tot_exposure / COALESCE(GREATEST(tot_limit, 1), 1)) > 1 THEN 'BREACH'
		    ELSE 'OK'
		  END AS status,
		  rating,
		  outlook,
		  tot_exposure/1000000 AS tot_exposure,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN -1
			WHEN tot_limit = 0 THEN 0
			ELSE tot_limit / 1000000
		  END AS tot_limit,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN '-'
			WHEN tot_exposure > tot_limit THEN '0'
			ELSE format('%,.0f', truncate( ( tot_limit - GREATEST( 0, tot_exposure ) ) / 1000000))
		  END AS tot_avail,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 OR tot_limit = 0 OR tot_limit IS NULL THEN 0
		  	ELSE ROUND( GREATEST( 0, tot_exposure / tot_limit * 100), 1)
		  END AS tot_usage
		FROM cred_exp_by_country
		UNION ALL
		SELECT
		  'Eurozone' AS country,
		  CASE
		    WHEN SUM( COALESCE( tot_exposure, 0 ) ) > region_fi_limit THEN 'BREACH'
		    ELSE 'OK'
		  END AS status,
		  '' AS rating,
		  '' AS outlook,
		  SUM( tot_exposure ) / 1000000 AS tot_exposure,
		  COALESCE( region_fi_limit / 1000000, 0 ) AS tot_limit,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN SUM( tot_exposure ) > region_fi_limit THEN '0'
			ELSE COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( region_fi_limit - GREATEST( 0, SUM( tot_exposure ) ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )
		  END AS tot_avail,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN region_fi_limit = 0 OR region_fi_limit IS NULL THEN 0
		  	ELSE ROUND( GREATEST( 0, SUM( tot_exposure ) / region_fi_limit * 100 ), 1 )
		  END AS tot_usage
		FROM cred_exp_by_country
		WHERE country IN ( 'France', 'Germany', 'Netherlands', 'Spain' )
		GROUP BY region_fi_limit
      ) c
    WHERE c.status <> 'OK'
	ORDER BY
	  CASE WHEN country = 'Eurozone' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
	  tot_exposure DESC

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 05 and 06
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 05:08:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

)
SELECT
    idx.index_family,
    idx.index_name,

    idx.index_series,
    idx.index_version,
    idx.index_factor,
    comp.index_clip,
    comp.component_ref_entity_ticker,

    comp.component_ref_entity_red,

    comp.component_currency,

    comp.component_coupon,
    evt.red_entity_code,

    evt.cerrd AS event_determination_date,
    evt.corporateaction_event_date,
    evt.default_date,
    evt.type,

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-25')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-25')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",

    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-05-25')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

SELECT from_currency as from_currency, 
    ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end, 8) as mid_price, 
    format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot' 
and business_date>=DATE '2000-01-01'
UNION
SELECT MainTable.to_currency as from_currency, 
    ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price, 
    format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
Left Join ( 
    SELECT case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end as mid_price, business_date
    FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
) as CAD_Rate on MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
WHERE MainTable.from_currency = 'USD' and MainTable.mid_price != 0 and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
and MainTable.business_date>=DATE '2000-01-01'
order by business_date, from_currency

/* cppi::af8e9c3e35e530d8588d7c0e8e4ece6ad55886abcd4db59e19d10e97b843bed8 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 10:28:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with max_ver as (select business_date, index_id, max(arrival_time) arrival_time
                    from performance.production_sa_index_local_excess_return 
                    where business_date between date '1989-07-31' and date '2025-02-01'

/* cppi::7fe3040fd5d101e46dd69600e62d70b4154602dbbe1c8d2ef5b399bbd7fd56ae */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 10:51:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 07 and 08
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 07:13:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

		COUNT(*) as counter

		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'

                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,

			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime

	GROUP BY

		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE

	GROUP BY

		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

        FROM (
		    SELECT

			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date

								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag

								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency

(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as cs01, run_id

where business_date = '2025-06-02'

left join
(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as dv01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(dv01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_dv01
where business_date = '2025-06-02' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id
) as e on var.run_id = e.run_id and e.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and e.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and e.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_level, pv, run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv 
where business_date = '2025-06-02'

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),
old_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_alert_date as (
    select *
    from old_alert_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)

			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,

		when null then 0
			else current_quantity
		END

		END
	)

	'' as instrument_group_name_source,
	'' as instrument_sub_type,
	'' as 	current_contract_id

/* cppi::240958faecf8d3a65ca67f567de5e557070c27428691c2afc28a078ea7f320fa */
/* QuickSight e71344c9-55ff-4b50-ae00-48b4e8416543 */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
